findings.message: The diff deletes `if result.rc != 0 and "failed" not in last.values(): findings.extend(report.findings)` and builds the report from per-test findings only. config.yaml's unit entry wraps pytest in `clutch coverage gate`. `run_gate` (clutch/covgate.py:146-148) returns pytest's nonzero rc before it evaluates coverage thresholds, so the first run with a failed test never checks coverage. Before this diff, the full-suite rerun evaluated the gate, and a coverage drop added a finding through the deleted line. Now the rerun runs only the selected ids, its gate result is thrown away, and nothing else checks coverage. A ticket that lowers coverage below `test-gate.toml` thresholds and hits one flaky test passes Check with no finding. Any other non-test cause of a nonzero exit on the rerun is also ignored. This weakens a gate, which the ticket does not allow (only the rerun's scope may change).
findings.paved_road: In stages.py, when a selected rerun turns every failed id into a pass, still enforce the whole-suite gate, for example: evaluate the first run's coverage report against the gate with the existing `clutch.covgate` functions, or run the full command once when the first run's rc may have hidden a gate failure. Add a test where the first run fails one test and also misses coverage, the selected rerun passes, and Check still reports a finding.

findings.message: The `test_results_fail_closed` case `[(1, {"a": "failed"}), (1, {"a": "passed"}), (0, {})]` asserted that a rerun exiting nonzero while recording passes fails closed. The diff replaces it with a missing-results case `(1, {})` instead of keeping that property. The ticket did not ask for this change (criterion 5 only requires the existing file to pass). It hides the gate bypass described in the previous finding.
findings.paved_road: Restore the original fail-closed case, or a version of it that fits the selected rerun, so that a nonzero rerun exit caused by something other than a recorded test failure (such as a coverage gate) still produces a finding. Keep the missing-results case as an additional parameter.
